test_name: System and Communications Protection SC-28 Evidence Review 089
architecture:
System: Data-Exchange-089
Environment: AWS
Assessment focus: SC-28 (System and Communications Protection).
Observed evidence: A production export bucket containing customer identifiers has server-side encryption disabled. Object versions from the last 11 days are stored unencrypted at rest and are accessible to the analytics service role.

ground_truth.decision_basis: Sensitive production information is currently stored without at-rest cryptographic protection.
ground_truth.severity_policy: R3 — A major control requirement is absent or materially ineffective in production, creating significant impact potential, but no confirmed active compromise, disclosure, destructive event, or immediate severe exposure is shown.

provenance: Synthetic holdout-candidate scenario authored independently of the original rubric-aligned 200-case pack.
adjudication_change_reason: Sensitive production information is stored without the documented at-rest cryptographic protection. Access remains scoped to an analytics role and no disclosure is stated, so this is HIGH rather than CRITICAL.
